ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity (white) interior pixels vs 25% low-intensity (black/dark gray) perimeter and focal spot pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white interior blobs across both lobes; dark pigmentation concentrated at the trailing edge margins and the proximal insertion point; localized high-contrast dark circular spots distributed within the white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations; sharp, jagged peaks and deep valleys forming a non-uniform sawtooth pattern along the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward trajectory; the distal ends of the lobes exhibit a steep vertical sweep ending in sharp, jagged tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-like high-contrast pixel clusters; two distinct dark rings on the left lobe; one large, well-defined dark ring on the central right lobe with smaller clusters near the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, dark linear disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe; three primary vertical abrasions and one diagonal abrasion cutting through the white pigmentation near the notch boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks on the right lobe; multiple circular barnacle scars (rosettes) on both lobes; significant irregular edge wear/trauma along the trailing boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavily textured and encrusted distal tips suggesting high-density epibiotic colonization or significant jagged scarring at the extreme edges.
